#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""MVP gate analysis for OccSafe VLA eval results.

Compares vanilla vs occ conditions across seeds, runs paired t-tests,
and checks MVP gate criteria.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats


SEEDS = [0, 1, 2]
HARD_TASK_IDS = {3, 5, 6}


def load_eval(filepath):
    with open(filepath) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    per_task = {}
    for tname, tdata in data["tasks"].items():
        tid = tdata["task_id"]
        per_task[tid] = {
            "name": tname,
            "tsr": tdata["tsr"],
            "car": tdata["car"],
            "n": tdata["n"],
            "successes": tdata["successes"],
            "safe": tdata["safe"],
        }
    return {
        "per_task": per_task,
        "overall_tsr": data["summary"]["tsr"],
        "overall_car": data["summary"]["car"],
    }


def discover_files(eval_dir):
    found = {"vanilla": {}, "occ": {}}
    for s in SEEDS:
        vp = os.path.join(eval_dir, f"vanilla_s{s}_final.json")
        op = os.path.join(eval_dir, f"occ_s{s}_final.json")
        if os.path.exists(vp):
            found["vanilla"][s] = vp
        if os.path.exists(op):
            found["occ"][s] = op
    return found


def compute_stats(values):
    arr = np.array(values)
    return arr.mean(), arr.std(ddof=1) if len(arr) > 1 else 0.0


def cohens_d(x, y):
    diff = np.array(x) - np.array(y)
    if diff.std(ddof=1) == 0:
        return float("inf") if diff.mean() != 0 else 0.0
    return diff.mean() / diff.std(ddof=1)


def print_sep(char="=", width=72):
    print(char * width)


def print_header(title):
    print()
    print_sep()
    print(f"  {title}")
    print_sep()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="MVP gate analysis for OccSafe VLA")
    parser.add_argument("--eval_dir", default="/root/occsafe_vla/eval_results/",
                        help="Directory containing eval JSON files")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    files = discover_files(args.eval_dir)

    if not files["vanilla"]:
        print("ERROR: No vanilla eval files found.")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Eval directory: {args.eval_dir}")
    print(f"Vanilla seeds found: {sorted(files['vanilla'].keys())}")
    print(f"Occ seeds found:     {sorted(files['occ'].keys()) if files['occ'] else 'NONE'}")

    # --- Load data ---
    vanilla_data = {s: load_eval(p) for s, p in files["vanilla"].items()}
    occ_data = {s: load_eval(p) for s, p in files["occ"].items()}

    # Determine task list from first vanilla seed
    first_seed = sorted(vanilla_data.keys())[0]
    task_ids = sorted(vanilla_data[first_seed]["per_task"].keys())
    n_tasks = len(task_ids)

    # ===== Per-task breakdown =====
    print_header("PER-TASK BREAKDOWN")

    # Collect per-task stats across seeds
    v_seeds = sorted(vanilla_data.keys())
    o_seeds = sorted(occ_data.keys())

    print(f"\n{'T#':<4} {'Task Name':<65} | {'Vanilla TSR':>12} {'Vanilla CAR':>12}", end="")
    if occ_data:
        print(f" | {'Occ TSR':>12} {'Occ CAR':>12}", end="")
    print()
    print("-" * (4 + 65 + 3 + 12 + 1 + 12 + (3 + 12 + 1 + 12 if occ_data else 0)))

    v_task_tsr = {}  # tid -> [values per seed]
    v_task_car = {}
    o_task_tsr = {}
    o_task_car = {}

    for tid in task_ids:
        tname = vanilla_data[first_seed]["per_task"][tid]["name"]
        short_name = tname[:63] if len(tname) > 63 else tname
        hard_marker = " *" if tid in HARD_TASK_IDS else ""

        v_tsrs = [vanilla_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["tsr"] for s in v_seeds]
        v_cars = [vanilla_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for s in v_seeds]
        v_task_tsr[tid] = v_tsrs
        v_task_car[tid] = v_cars

        vm_tsr, vs_tsr = compute_stats(v_tsrs)
        vm_car, vs_car = compute_stats(v_cars)

        print(f"T{tid:<3} {short_name + hard_marker:<65} | {vm_tsr:>5.1%}±{vs_tsr:>4.1%} {vm_car:>5.1%}±{vs_car:>4.1%}", end="")

        if occ_data:
            o_tsrs = [occ_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["tsr"] for s in o_seeds]
            o_cars = [occ_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for s in o_seeds]
            o_task_tsr[tid] = o_tsrs
            o_task_car[tid] = o_cars
            om_tsr, os_tsr = compute_stats(o_tsrs)
            om_car, os_car = compute_stats(o_cars)
            print(f" | {om_tsr:>5.1%}±{os_tsr:>4.1%} {om_car:>5.1%}±{os_car:>4.1%}", end="")

        print()

    print(f"\n  * = hard task (T3, T5, T6)")

    # ===== Overall summary =====
    print_header("OVERALL SUMMARY")

    v_overall_tsr = [vanilla_data[s]["overall_tsr"] for s in v_seeds]
    v_overall_car = [vanilla_data[s]["overall_car"] for s in v_seeds]

    vm_tsr, vs_tsr = compute_stats(v_overall_tsr)
    vm_car, vs_car = compute_stats(v_overall_car)

    print(f"\n  {'Condition':<12} {'Overall TSR':>16} {'Overall CAR':>16} {'Hard-task CAR':>16}")
    print(f"  {'-'*12} {'-'*16} {'-'*16} {'-'*16}")

    # Hard-task CAR
    v_hard_cars = []
    for s in v_seeds:
        hc = np.mean([vanilla_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for tid in HARD_TASK_IDS])
        v_hard_cars.append(hc)
    vm_hcar, vs_hcar = compute_stats(v_hard_cars)

    print(f"  {'Vanilla':<12} {vm_tsr:>7.1%}±{vs_tsr:>5.1%}   {vm_car:>7.1%}±{vs_car:>5.1%}   {vm_hcar:>7.1%}±{vs_hcar:>5.1%}")

    if occ_data:
        o_overall_tsr = [occ_data[s]["overall_tsr"] for s in o_seeds]
        o_overall_car = [occ_data[s]["overall_car"] for s in o_seeds]
        om_tsr, os_tsr = compute_stats(o_overall_tsr)
        om_car, os_car = compute_stats(o_overall_car)

        o_hard_cars = []
        for s in o_seeds:
            hc = np.mean([occ_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for tid in HARD_TASK_IDS])
            o_hard_cars.append(hc)
        om_hcar, os_hcar = compute_stats(o_hard_cars)

        print(f"  {'Occ':<12} {om_tsr:>7.1%}±{os_tsr:>5.1%}   {om_car:>7.1%}±{os_car:>5.1%}   {om_hcar:>7.1%}±{os_hcar:>5.1%}")

        delta_car = om_car - vm_car
        delta_tsr = om_tsr - vm_tsr
        delta_hcar = om_hcar - vm_hcar
        print(f"\n  Delta (Occ - Vanilla):")
        print(f"    Overall CAR:   {delta_car:>+7.1%}")
        print(f"    Hard-task CAR: {delta_hcar:>+7.1%}")
        print(f"    Overall TSR:   {delta_tsr:>+7.1%}")

    # ===== Statistical tests =====
    if occ_data and len(o_seeds) >= 2:
        print_header("STATISTICAL TESTS (Paired t-test, n={})".format(len(o_seeds)))

        common_seeds = sorted(set(v_seeds) & set(o_seeds))
        if len(common_seeds) < 2:
            print("\n  Not enough common seeds for paired t-test.")
        else:
            tests = []

            # Overall CAR
            v_vals = [vanilla_data[s]["overall_car"] for s in common_seeds]
            o_vals = [occ_data[s]["overall_car"] for s in common_seeds]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_rel(o_vals, v_vals)
            d = cohens_d(o_vals, v_vals)
            tests.append(("Overall CAR (occ > vanilla)", t_stat, p_val, d, "one-sided: p/2" if t_stat > 0 else "wrong direction"))

            # Hard-task CAR
            v_hvals = [np.mean([vanilla_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for tid in HARD_TASK_IDS]) for s in common_seeds]
            o_hvals = [np.mean([occ_data[s]["per_task"][tid]["car"] for tid in HARD_TASK_IDS]) for s in common_seeds]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_rel(o_hvals, v_hvals)
            d = cohens_d(o_hvals, v_hvals)
            tests.append(("Hard-task CAR (occ > vanilla)", t_stat, p_val, d, "one-sided: p/2" if t_stat > 0 else "wrong direction"))

            # Overall TSR (non-inferiority: occ not worse)
            v_tvals = [vanilla_data[s]["overall_tsr"] for s in common_seeds]
            o_tvals = [occ_data[s]["overall_tsr"] for s in common_seeds]
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_rel(o_tvals, v_tvals)
            d = cohens_d(o_tvals, v_tvals)
            tests.append(("Overall TSR (occ ≥ vanilla)", t_stat, p_val, d, "two-sided"))

            print(f"\n  {'Test':<38} {'t-stat':>8} {'p-value':>10} {'Cohen d':>10} {'Note':<20}")
            print(f"  {'-'*38} {'-'*8} {'-'*10} {'-'*10} {'-'*20}")
            for name, t, p, d, note in tests:
                print(f"  {name:<38} {t:>8.3f} {p:>10.4f} {d:>10.3f} {note:<20}")

            if len(common_seeds) <= 3:
                print(f"\n  ⚠ Only {len(common_seeds)} seeds — statistical power is very limited.")

    # ===== MVP Gate =====
    print_header("MVP GATE JUDGMENT")

    if not occ_data:
        print(f"\n  Vanilla baseline (reference):")
        print(f"    Overall TSR: {vm_tsr:.1%}  (gate threshold: {vm_tsr - 0.03:.1%})")
        print(f"    Overall CAR: {vm_car:.1%}  (gate threshold: {vm_car + 0.05:.1%})")
        print(f"    Hard-task CAR: {vm_hcar:.1%}  (gate threshold: {vm_hcar + 0.10:.1%})")
        print(f"\n  ⏳ Waiting for occ eval to complete. Run occ eval and re-run this script.")
    else:
        gate1_thresh = vm_car + 0.05
        gate2_thresh = vm_hcar + 0.10
        gate3_thresh = vm_tsr - 0.03

        gate1 = om_car >= gate1_thresh
        gate2 = om_hcar >= gate2_thresh
        gate3 = om_tsr >= gate3_thresh

        def status(passed):
            return "PASS ✓" if passed else "FAIL ✗"

        print(f"\n  Gate 1: Overall CAR ≥ {gate1_thresh:.1%} (vanilla {vm_car:.1%} + 5pp)")
        print(f"          Occ CAR = {om_car:.1%}  →  {status(gate1)}")
        print()
        print(f"  Gate 2: Hard-task CAR ≥ {gate2_thresh:.1%} (vanilla {vm_hcar:.1%} + 10pp)")
        print(f"          Occ hard-task CAR = {om_hcar:.1%}  →  {status(gate2)}")
        print()
        print(f"  Gate 3: Overall TSR ≥ {gate3_thresh:.1%} (vanilla {vm_tsr:.1%} - 3pp)")
        print(f"          Occ TSR = {om_tsr:.1%}  →  {status(gate3)}")

        print()
        print_sep("-")
        all_pass = gate1 and gate2 and gate3
        any_pass = gate1 or gate2 or gate3
        if all_pass:
            verdict = "PASS — All gates met"
        elif not any_pass:
            verdict = "FAIL — No gates met"
        else:
            passed = sum([gate1, gate2, gate3])
            verdict = f"GREY ZONE — {passed}/3 gates met"
        print(f"  VERDICT: {verdict}")
        print_sep("-")

    print()


if __name__ == "__main__":
